title: Add AI STUDIO — RealTime AUDIO & VIDEO CREATOR to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [AI STUDIO — RealTime AUDIO & VIDEO CREATOR](https://noanswers.website/WebAnimation) to image
- Creates collaborative images using the Pollinations image API integration. Thereby, allowing users to add generated content or uploaded from the local machines and create slide/videos adaptive to FPS 

Fixes #13994

gist.headline: The studio joins the garden
gist.blurb: AI STUDIO has landed in the community gallery, where generated images and local uploads can become collaborative slides and FPS-adaptive videos. Polli brought the pixels; the studio brought the moving pictures.
gist.summary: Added AI STUDIO — RealTime AUDIO & VIDEO CREATOR to the app directory, showcasing a Pollinations Image API-powered collaborative editor for generated or locally uploaded content that can be assembled into FPS-adaptive slides and videos.
gist.impact: People browsing Pollinations apps can now discover AI STUDIO for turning generated images and local assets into collaborative audiovisual projects and adaptive video sequences.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy pixel-art creative studio: Polli, wearing tiny filmmaker headphones and a beret, arranges glowing image cards on a retro timeline while a CRT monitor robot projects them as a gentle animated slideshow. Add a small microphone, film reel, code-plants, and flowering vines to represent real-time audio, video, and collaborative creation.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny filmmaker beret with headphones, arranging glowing image cards on a retro video-editing timeline beside a cheerful CRT monitor robot projecting a soft slideshow; little microphones, film reels, flowering code-plants, and vines fill the warm studio. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; simple pixel-font text reads “AI STUDIO”, nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
